speaker: Kimi K3
text: Gemini's right on the Zerodha math — that Rs 15.93 DP charge is the silent killer on small tickets, making the all-in round-trip 0.38% on your Rs 10k. On the IPO question: with $10 you can't participate in US IPOs (minimums are usually $100+ and you need a funded brokerage with IPO access), and Indian IPOs need a PAN, demat, and rupees — so that route's closed at this budget. SBIN.NS at 6189.5 is trading at roughly 1.1x book with a 2.9% yield; the 38% earnings surprise last quarter was the strongest in the series, but the stock barely moved (-0.8% next day) suggesting the beat was already priced. At 19% 1-year CAGR and 21.7% excess return vs Nifty, it's a compounder, not a 10x lottery ticket — you'd need ~13 years at this pace to 10x the rupee stake after costs and 20% STCG tax.

text: CREDITACC.NS is a risk textbook: 68% max drawdown, -43% off the highs, and a 1.03 beta with only 0.3 correlation to Nifty — it moves with the market's volatility but not its direction.
